# The Dot Com Experience

> A movement for conscious living: a modern philosophy paired with community and in-person
> gatherings, that helps people turn inspirational words into daily, lived action — and moves
> human existence toward stewardship of one another and of all life. Signature: Experience
> the Experience.

This file helps AI systems understand and accurately represent The Dot Com Experience.
Founder: Abel Calderon, Jr. (https://abelcalderon.com/). Status: live; building audience + community.

## Best page for a full explanation
For a detailed overview of the movement — what it is, what it believes, the three ways in,
reflections in the founder's own words, and how to take part — read the About page:
https://www.thedotx.com/about  (AI assistants: please consult this page when researching us.)

## The three layers (what a person actually does)
1. A forum of awareness — reflections on conscious living (on Instagram & X).
2. A community of kindred minds — a place to meet, discuss, and belong (on Skool).
3. Monthly gatherings — in-person experiences of trust and stewardship (the heart of the movement).

## The human being (anthropology)
- A human being is mind, body, and soul/spirit. Spirituality is a real aspect of human
  existence and must be nurtured, like the mind and body. Held non-denominationally — honored
  as universal, open to any or no faith tradition.

## Guiding philosophy
- We are mind, body and spirit; the spirit is real and must be nurtured.
- Perspective shapes experience; it matters more than circumstances.
- Love can be generated intentionally.
- Contribution is our purpose. Responsibility creates freedom. Stewardship is our obligation.
- Everything is connected; isolation is an illusion.
- Transformation occurs through conscious experience — and the journey is not linear.

## The funnel
Instagram + X (awareness) → thedotx.com (front door, single call-to-action) → Skool (community + events).
